templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from multi-tier by the note-writer: a control pipeline (top) is split from a two-cloud WAN topology (bottom) by function, not by stacked machine tiers; this is a control-data split with one bridging arrow, matching its own corpus_template.
templates.what_to_learn: When a figure's real split is control-plane pipeline above versus data-plane topology below, bridge them with one clearly labelled vertical arrow rather than several, and reach for stacked tier rows only when boxes represent different machines, not different concerns; name the bridging arrow's endpoint, since this figure leaves it unlabelled.
